Director, AI Strategy

Acme Analytics - Denver, CO (hybrid)

Posted 2026-10-28. Applications close 2026-11-30.

About the role

We are hiring a Director of AI Strategy to define and lead our enterprise AI agenda. You will report to the Chief Digital Officer, lead a team of six strategy and transformation managers, and advise the executive committee on AI investment priorities.

What you will do

  • Own the enterprise AI strategy and roadmap across business lines
  • Lead AI transformation programs from pilot to scaled adoption
  • Build the AI operating model: governance, risk, and talent
  • Partner with engineering leadership on platform decisions

What you bring

  • 10+ years in strategy, transformation, or digital leadership roles
  • Track record delivering enterprise AI or digital transformation programs
  • Executive communication and stakeholder management at C-level
Acme Analytics is an equal opportunity employer.
